title: Self-Calibrating Spatial Reaction-Mass Actuation Platform
description: English technical disclosure of a generalized self-calibrating spatial reaction-mass actuation architecture. Preferred embodiments include controlled magnetic or ferromagnetic movers in closed electromagnetic spatial guideways, learned force/torque response maps, multi-axis compensation, surface-coupled locomotion, compliant-support impulse assistance, and a spherical mobile demonstrator with potential hop-assisted motion.
